fusions.name: Headwind Blast
fusions.desc: Beats a gale into the target that deals 10 damage, pushes it back 3.5 tiles and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Full Broadside
fusions.desc: Looses 5 bolts spread apart, each dealing 8 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Trimmed Sails
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 15% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Steady Heading
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.
